apply Metric.ediam_le
intro x hx y hy

    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
      ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2),
      ← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
    norm_num
